newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Ship bursts into flames at Indonesian port.
newsitem.headline: Ship bursts into flames at Indonesian port.

text.p: An Indonesian cargo ship burst into flames while being repaired at the main Jakarta port on Monday, but there were no immediate reports of casualties, a port official said.
He said tugs had towed the 2,566-tonne MT Wakeke, owned by PT Pejaka, away from the docks at the Tanjung Priok port, where it was being repaired.
"The ship was towed by tugboats away from the port area and is now at a place where it will not disturb traffic at the port," the official told Reuters.
"There was one explosion, but we have had no reports yet of anyone being injured by the blast or the fire," he said, adding that the fire was dying out.
He said the cause of the explosion was not immediately known. There was no cargo aboard the vessel.
